purpose: Teach: 英単語/地中海/フック/麓/猟/カウントダウン/詩集/強風

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、英単語、毎日、十個ずつ、覚えてるよ、ママ、本当に、頑張ってるの、ぼく、覚悟、見てね、約束、絶対、続けるからね、お母さん、応援、よろしくね、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Mom, I'm learning ten English words every day. I'm really trying, I promise. Watch me — I'm going to keep going, I mean it.
lines.style: Earnest and intent, speaking faster with the energy of wanting to convince. Each clause lands with quiet commitment. Slight breathiness showing the effort of the promise. No performance—just a 6-year-old being completely serious.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お母さんの友達、地中海クルーズ、行ったって、聞いたわよ、翔くん、いつか、家族で、行けたら、いいわね、ね、夢ね、本気で、絶対、楽しみよ、本当に、本気で、約束しようね。
lines.en: Mm. Your mom's friend went on a Mediterranean cruise, you know. Sho, maybe someday we can go as a family too. That would be nice, wouldn't it? A dream. Really nice.
lines.style: Gently wistful, voice softening on the word 'dream'. Slower pace—she's picturing it as she speaks. Warm but distant, like she's half-talking to herself. Trails off at the end, tender and open.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おもちゃの釣り竿に、フック、ついてるんだよ、ママ、見て、本当に、リアルでしょ?ぼく、お父さんと、一緒に、釣り、行きたいよ、約束、絶対、楽しみだよ、本当に、本気で、お願い、ね。
lines.en: Mom, look—this toy fishing rod has a hook on it. See? It's pretty realistic, right? I really want to go fishing with Dad. I mean it. I'm so excited, please?
lines.style: Bright and animated, pulling her attention to the toy with urgency. Pace picks up on 'I want to go fishing.' The please at the end is genuine asking, not performing—a small voice hoping she'll understand how much this matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 昨日、お父さん、山の麓のキャンプ場、予約してくれたわよ、翔くん、家族で、行きましょうね、本当に、楽しみね、本気で、絶対、わくわくしてるわよね、皆、ね、楽しみ。
lines.en: Your dad booked us a campsite at the foot of the mountain yesterday, you know. We're all going to go together as a family, Sho. I'm really looking forward to it. Everyone is excited.
lines.style: Warm and assured, speaking as if the plan is already real and solid. Steady pace with a lift on 'going together.' Genuine delight underneath—she's picturing the family there. The closing 'everyone is excited' feels like she's drawing him into something already decided and safe.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、狩猟、してたって、本当?ママ、ぼく、信じられないよ、お祖父ちゃん、優しい人なのに、本当に、すごい話、聞いたよ、本当に、ね、お父さんから、聞いた。
lines.en: Mom, is it really true that Grandpa went hunting when he was young? I can't believe it—he's such a kind person. That's such an amazing story. Dad told me about it.
lines.style: Genuinely startled, voice lifting slightly on the question. Thoughtful pause before 'he's such a kind person'—he's working through the contradiction. Quiet wonder, not loudness. The tone of someone discovering something that doesn't fit what he thought he knew.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 大晦日、家族で、カウントダウン、するの、本当に、楽しみよね、翔くん、ママ、お父さん、皆、揃って、本気で、楽しみたいよね、本当に、絶対、家族の伝統よね、本気で、楽しみ。
lines.en: New Year's Eve—we'll do a countdown as a family. I'm really looking forward to it, Sho. Mom and Dad and everyone all together. It's one of our family traditions, and I want to enjoy it together, really enjoy it.
lines.style: Voice warm and settled, speaking with the certainty of ritual. Gentle emphasis on 'all together'—this matters to her. Slower pace, almost reverent. Not loud or performative, but grounded. She's speaking as much to herself as to him, anchoring the family to this moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お母さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんから、もらった詩集、ぼく、本当に、好きなの、毎晩、寝る前に、読んでるんだよ、ママ、本当に、いい本だよ、お祖母ちゃん、優しい、本当に、ありがとう。
lines.en: Mom, the poetry book Grandma gave me—I really love it. I read it every night before bed. It's such a good book. Grandma was so kind to give it to me.
lines.style: Soft and genuine, the voice of someone treasuring something quietly. Steady, unhurried pace. When he says 'every night' there's a small sense of ritual and care. The gratitude at the end is simple and complete—no extra emotion needed, just clear feeling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 明日、台風で、強風、注意報、出てるみたいね、翔くん、外、危険だから、家で、ゆっくり、過ごしましょうね、ね、絶対、約束、ね、お母さんと、お話、いっぱい、しようね。
lines.en: There's a typhoon warning for tomorrow—strong winds. It'll be dangerous outside, so let's stay home and relax together, okay? I promise. Let's talk together—just you and me.
lines.style: Calm and practical, but with an undercurrent of care. Clear, measured speech—she's establishing safety. When she says 'let's talk together' her voice softens, becomes more inviting. Not worried, but protective. The closing feels like an invitation, not an instruction.
